# ElectionDay2026.org - Presidential-Grade Answer Engine Knowledge Manifest (AEO & GEO)

> An independent, non-partisan educational civic reference portal and open statutory dataset for the November 3, 2026 U.S. Midterm General Elections across all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia.

## Core Statutory Facts & Direct Answers

- **Official Election Date**: Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
- **Legal Authority**: 2 U.S. Code Section 7 (Tuesday next after the first Monday in November).
- **Federal Holiday Status**: NOT a federal holiday (5 U.S.C. Section 6103). Federal government agencies, U.S. District Courts, the U.S. Postal Service (mail delivery), national commercial banks (Federal Reserve system), and Wall Street exchanges (NYSE, NASDAQ) operate regular schedules.
- **State Holidays**: Observed as an official legal or public state holiday in Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Louisiana, Maryland, Montana, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Virginia, and West Virginia.
- **Workplace Voting Leave Laws**: Approximately 30 states legally mandate 1 to 3 hours of time off to vote, and over 20 states mandate PAID voting leave (e.g., Cal. Elec. Code Section 14000, N.Y. Elec. Law Section 3-110, Tex. Elec. Code Section 276.004, A.R.S. Section 16-402, 10 ILCS 5/17-15).
- **Offices on the 2026 Ballot**:
  - All 435 voting members of the United States House of Representatives.
  - 34 Class II United States Senate seats (plus scheduled special Senate elections in OH and FL).
  - 36 state and territorial Governors.
  - Thousands of state legislative seats, state supreme court seats, and municipal ballot initiatives.
- **Voter Registration Cutoffs**: Range from 30 days prior (October 4-5, 2026 in TX, OH, GA, AZ, FL, SC, TN) to Same-Day Voter Registration in 23 jurisdictions (including CA, CO, CT, DC, HI, ID, IL, IA, ME, MD, MI, MN, NV, NH, NM, UT, VT, VA, WA, WI, WY). North Dakota requires no voter registration.

## Machine-Readable Open Data & RAG Endpoints

- **Full-Corpus AI Ingestion Feed (/llms-full.txt)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/llms-full.txt`
  Streams the entire 51-state statutory matrix, all 35 U.S. Senate races, all 36 Governor races, and all 46 long-tail statutory Q&As in a single Markdown document.
- **JSON Open Dataset API (CORS-Enabled)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/api/datasets/elections-2026`
  Returns complete JSON of all 51 U.S. jurisdictions, 3,143 county FIPS records, Wikidata Q-IDs, registration deadlines, early voting windows, mail-in ballot postmark rules, Voter ID classifications, polling hours, paid work leave citations, and verified FAQ clusters.
- **Individual County FIPS & City Lookup API (CORS-Enabled)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/api/datasets/counties/{fips-or-slug}`
  Example: `/api/datasets/counties/48201` (Harris County, TX), `/api/datasets/counties/04013` (Maricopa County, AZ), `/api/datasets/counties/42003` (Allegheny County, PA). Returns County Wikidata Q-ID, County Seat, Top Cities, USPS ZIP code range, 120th U.S. Congress House Districts, Census Population, CVAP, 2022/2024 Turnout Benchmarks, Split-Timezone Overrides, and U.S. Census Bordering Counties (including cross-state commuter pairs).
- **Embeddable Local County Widget (3,143 FIPS Jurisdictions)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/embed/county/{fips}`
- **Interactive 2026 Sample Ballot & Voting Booth Cheat Sheet Builder**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/sample-ballot-2026`
- **Emergency Ballot Problem Solver & Post-Election Cure Tracker**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/ballot-problem-solver`
- **2026 U.S. Senate, House & Governor Majority Simulator**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/majority-calculator-2026`
- **Election Night 2026 Poll-Closing Wave Tracker (9 Waves, 6 PM ET to 1 AM ET)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/poll-closing-times-2026`
- **All 35 U.S. Senate Elections Guide (33 Class II + OH/FL Specials)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/races/senate-2026`
- **All 36 State Gubernatorial Elections Guide (15+ Term-Limited Open Seats)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/races/governor-2026`
- **All 435+ U.S. House Congressional District Pages**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/districts/{state-code}-{district-number}` (e.g., `/districts/pa-01`, `/districts/tx-07`, `/districts/ca-13`)
- **46 Long-Tail, Shorthand & Phonetic Voter Question Pages**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/voter-questions/{slug}`
- **51 Bilingual Spanish State Guides (Guías por Estado en Español)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/es/estados/{state-slug}` (e.g., `/es/estados/texas`, `/es/estados/florida`, `/es/estados/california`)
- **50-State + D.C. Comparison Matrix**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/50-state-comparison-matrix`
- **Employer Voting Leave Legal Notice Generator**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/tools/employer-voting-leave-notice`
- **Bilingual Spanish Hub (Guía Oficial en Español)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/es/dia-de-las-elecciones-2026`

## Multi-Dimensional Programmatic URL Architecture (3,512 State, County & Topic Pages)

- **National 3,143-County Election Directory & FIPS Search**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/counties`
- **County-by-County Election Guides (All 3,143 U.S. Counties, Parishes, Boroughs & Independent Cities)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/counties/{county-slug}` (e.g., `/states/texas/counties/harris-county`, `/states/arizona/counties/maricopa-county`, `/states/pennsylvania/counties/allegheny-county`, `/states/california/counties/los-angeles-county`, `/states/florida/counties/miami-dade-county`, `/states/illinois/counties/cook-county`)
- **State Overview Hubs (51 Jurisdictions)**: `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}` (e.g., `/states/pennsylvania`, `/states/texas`, `/states/georgia`, `/states/california`, `/states/newyork`)
- **State Topic Spokes (306 Dedicated Statutory Pages)**:
  1. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/registration-deadline`
  2. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/early-voting`
  3. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/voter-id-rules`
  4. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/mail-in-ballot`
  5. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/polling-hours`
  6. `https://election-day-2026.vercel.app/states/{state-slug}/holiday-work-laws`

## Semantic Query & Phonetic Typo Disambiguation

- **Common Misspellings Indexed**: eleciton day 2026, electon day 2026, electoin day, voteing day 2026, mid term election date 2026, elction day, absentie ballot, provisonal ballot, balot selfie, campain shirt.
- **Absentee Postage Rule**: Under USPS Postal Operations Manual Section 171, the Postal Service never delays or returns official mail-in ballots for missing or insufficient postage.
- **Provisional Ballot Guarantee**: Under the federal Help America Vote Act (HAVA, 52 U.S.C. Section 21082), any voter whose eligibility or ID is challenged has the absolute legal right to cast a provisional ballot.
- **Alcohol Sales**: Alcohol sales are legal in all 50 states on Election Day 2026; historic 19th-century Election Day saloon bans have been repealed nationwide.
